subject: Cross-border invoice routing and VAT reconciliation for NovoHealth pilot
messages:
From: Amelia Cruz <amelia.cruz@novohealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Cross-border billing for pilot — invoicing needs

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo. We’re ready to move the pilot to a short paid trial but I need to clarify how invoicing will work across our entities. NovoHealth operates in the UK and the Netherlands; procurement requires separate invoices per legal entity (NovoHealth UK Ltd and NovoHealth NL B.V.) with the correct VAT IDs and payment instructions.

A few specific asks from finance:
- Can Redwood issue separate invoices split by entity for a single aggregated usage run (so we can allocate cost to our UK and NL cost centers)?
- We need VAT treatment documented per invoice (either VAT charged or reverse-charge noted) and Redwood’s VAT registration evidence for each invoicing entity.
- Our auditors want payment remittance details per-entity (bank account + IBAN) on the invoice.

I attached our PO (PO-8821) for the pilot. Can you send a proposed invoice layout and confirm if Redwood can support per-entity split invoices (or whether we need to route payment centrally)?

Best,
Amelia
Amelia Cruz
Head of Procurement, NovoHealth
amelia.cruz@novohealth.com
Attachment: PO-8821-NovoHealth.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Cruz <amelia.cruz@novohealth.com>
Cc: Paul Jensen <paul.j@novohealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border billing for pilot — invoicing needs

Hi Amelia —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can support split invoices for the pilot. High-level approach I propose:

- Issue separate PDF invoices per Redwood legal entity that is tax-registered in the relevant jurisdiction (e.g., Redwood Labs B.V. for NL, Redwood Software Ltd for UK).
- Each invoice will include the NovoHealth cost center tag and a line-level allocation so your ledger can map charges to the correct internal entity.
- We will include VAT registration numbers and, where applicable, use the reverse-charge annotation on customer-facing invoices for B2B EU transactions.
- Payment instructions (bank/IBAN) will be shown per-invoice.

I’m attaching a simple allocation template and a sample line-item breakdown so you can confirm the fields your AP system expects (cost center, GL code, PO reference). Once you confirm, I’ll loop in our billing team to produce draft invoices.

Next steps: can you confirm the split percentages (or rules) between UK/NL for the pilot? If not, we can invoice gross split by country of consumption or by a fixed split you specify.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Attachments: invoice-allocation-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Amelia Cruz <amelia.cruz@novohealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border billing for pilot — invoicing needs

Thanks Lauren — that sounds promising.

A few clarifications from our finance team:
1) We prefer definitive invoices per legal entity (two invoices) rather than one invoice with allocation lines.
2) For the pilot, split by usage origin: 70% NL, 30% UK. If you can’t do origin-based routing we can accept a manually defined split.
3) For VAT: NovoHealth is B2B in both countries, so in most cases reverse-charge will apply — we still need your VAT IDs and a PDF copy of each entity’s VAT registration to attach to our files.
4) Payment terms: Net 30 is standard for us. Please confirm your payment term per invoice.

I’ve attached PO-8821 (again) and marked the required fields on page 2 for the invoice.

If you can produce draft invoices I can get internal sign-off quickly and route to AP.

Best,
Amelia
Attachment: PO-8821-NovoHealth.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-13T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Cross-border billing for pilot — invoicing needs

Hi Rishi / Marcus —

FWD’ing NovoHealth’s asks. Summary: they require two separate invoices (UK & NL), VAT registration evidence per Redwood entity, per-entity bank details, Net 30, and a 70/30 split (NL/UK) for the pilot. PO attached.

Can you draft invoices using our standard legal entities and confirm:
- Which Redwood legal entities we should use (provide official names + VAT numbers)
- Bank details/beneficiary per entity (IBAN/SWIFT)
- Any constraints on reverse-charge / VAT treatment for B2B EU customers
- A single PDF with both draft invoices (we’ll send as attachments to Novo)

Looping Marcus for ledger tagging: please ensure each invoice includes a cost_center meta field and a mapping line we can include in the PDF (GL: XXXX).

Thanks — Amelia is copied so you have direct contact for any missing fields.

—Lauren
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

   - VAT: NL123456789B01

Thanks,
